digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, September 7, with five active calendar entries, four urgent items, six carried-over tasks, and no active reminders. Use the open 9:00 AM-noon runway to settle the Amazon Connect calling-policy, integration-account, and attorney-platform decisions, review the executive update deck, and prepare for the required 12:30 PM UAT access check. The main risk is carrying unresolved business controls into Tuesday's compressed UAT kickoff schedule; the 10:30 AM SVC standup is canceled. The repository state snapshot is more than 24 hours old, so carry-over is based on the latest available GitHub state and Friday's end-of-day confirmation.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect calling-policy path
items.detail: Choose the platform for new offices and close the outbound caller-ID, callback-routing, and number-blocking rules before Tuesday's UAT kickoff sequence. Queue transfer is still being worked, while language prompts need the Salesforce-side update.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, with the required permissions and monitoring. Friday closed without the requested update.

items.label: Decide the attorney calling-platform treatment
items.detail: Close whether attorneys join Amazon Connect or remain in RingCentral, then align the training audience and RAID entry before UAT begins.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP and training path
items.detail: Training starts September 8 while the SOPs remain under review. Confirm that training can proceed, secure the remaining approvals, and protect the September 15 Contigo launch.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: This cleanup has remained open across several briefings. Use the noon block to close stale entries and leave one current operating view before this week's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing now that the refresher training is available.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare the week
items.detail: Clear approvals and set the day's decision order before the open morning runway.

items.label: 9:00 AM-noon - Open preparation window
items.detail: The 10:30 AM SVC Daily Standup was canceled. Use the recovered time for the Amazon Connect decisions and Sara's executive-deck review request.

items.label: Noon-1:30 PM - Focus block with required access check
items.detail: At 12:30 PM, confirm Salesforce UAT access, Omni-Channel, voice availability, and the assigned tester workbook tab. No live meeting is required.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - BD Portfolio Review and Maria 1:1
items.detail: Use the portfolio review for active risks and intake decisions, then close the Maria 1:1 with explicit owners and next steps.

items.label: Complete the Amazon Connect UAT access check
items.detail: Finish the required 10-minute check by 12:40 PM and raise any Salesforce UAT, Omni-Channel, voice, or workbook-access issue before Tuesday's kickoff.

items.label: Review the executive updates deck
items.detail: Sara asked for the same thorough Monday review used in recent weeks and an added slide showing every EPMO project completed in August. Use today's open morning so tomorrow's slide block is reserved for final polish.

items.label: Confirm the Enterprise Knowledge Management project record
items.detail: Weekend Asana alerts show the project was shared with you and then deleted minutes later. Confirm with Eugenia whether the deletion was intentional and which record should remain authoritative.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Double-booked start and slide focus
items.detail: The Jhara 1:1 overlaps SVC Daily Standup at 10:30 AM, followed immediately by a 30-minute EPMO slide focus block.

items.label: 1:00-3:00 PM - Leadership meetings collide with UAT
items.detail: CSO GLs Huddle runs 1:00-2:00 PM. EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up at 2:00 PM overlaps the 2:15 PM Group 4 UAT kickoff.

items.label: 3:00-5:45 PM - Amazon Connect kickoff sequence
items.detail: Group 2 starts at 3:00 PM and overlaps the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1; Groups 3 and 1 follow at 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM. Resolve coverage today.
